description: More Reactive Companions compatibility test. P1 — re-verifies Osiris and Events behavior on the latest extender.
assertions: assert((function() for _,u in ipairs(Ext.Mod.GetLoadOrder()) do local m=Ext.Mod.GetMod(u); local n=string.gsub(string.lower((m and m.Info and m.Info.Name) or ''), '[%s_%-]', ''); if string.find(n, 'morereactivecompanions', 1, true) then return true end end return false end)(), 'More Reactive Companions present in load order')
assert((function() local id=Ext.Events.Tick:Subscribe(function() end); local ok=type(id) == 'number'; Ext.Events.Tick:Unsubscribe(id); return ok end)(), 'Tick event subscribe roundtrip executes')
notes: Does not require MCM. Already confirmed working on v0.36.17; this scenario re-verifies it on the latest extender.
